title: Unpacking the Nuances of Industrial Agglomerations and their Impact on Manufacturing Firm Performance in Emerging Economies
affiliations: , University of Valencia and Universitat Politècnica de València

detail.title: Unpacking the Nuances of Industrial Agglomerations and their Impact on Manufacturing Firm Performance in Emerging Economies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Management Research: Journal of the Iberoamerican Academy of Management, 0[10.1108/MRJIAM-05-2025-1724]

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes how different types of location (industrial clusters, urban agglomerations, and isolated areas) shape firm performance in emerging economies. It also examines whether innovativeness, understood as a firm's capability to adapt and transform its activities, mediates the location-performance relationship. We use firm-level data from 190 Ecuadorian textile and apparel SMEs (2014-2019). Locations are classified through Location Quotients, and innovativeness is operationalized via a composite index derived from Principal Component Analysis. Hypotheses are tested using ANOVA and regression models. Results indicate that firms in industrial clusters outperform those in other locations, but the location alone does not guarantee superior performance. Innovativeness strengthens profitability, particularly in industrial clusters, while isolated firms rely more on efficiency-driven strategies. Interaction effects are weak, reflecting both data imbalance and the contingent nature of locationinnovation linkages. Managers should adopt innovation-oriented business models to capitalize on agglomeration benefits. Policymakers, in turn, must design territorially sensitive instruments for industrial clusters, urban agglomerations, and isolated areas. Supporting innovative firms outside major agglomerations can foster regional development and reduce inequality. This study offers one of the first systematic analyses linking agglomeration typologies and innovativeness to firm performance in Latin America. It refines distinctions between industrial clusters, urban agglomeration, and isolated areas and conceptualizes innovativeness as a dynamic capability in institutionally weak environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了不同区位类型（产业集群、城市集聚区和孤立地区）如何影响新兴经济体中的企业绩效，并检验了创新性（企业适应和转型能力）在区位-绩效关系中的中介作用。基于厄瓜多尔190家纺织服装中小企业数据，发现产业集群中的企业表现更优，但区位本身不保证卓越绩效。创新性增强盈利能力，尤其在产业集群中，而孤立企业更依赖效率驱动策略。
AI.research_question: 不同区位类型（产业集群、城市集聚区和孤立地区）如何影响新兴经济体中的企业绩效？创新性是否在区位-绩效关系中起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 理解新兴经济体中区位对企业绩效的影响机制，特别是在拉丁美洲背景下，缺乏系统分析不同集聚类型与创新性动态能力关系的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集聚经济理论、区位理论、动态能力理论（将创新性概念化为机构薄弱环境中的动态能力）
AI.method: 使用厄瓜多尔190家纺织服装中小企业2014-2019年数据；通过区位商分类区位类型；通过主成分分析构建创新性综合指数；使用ANOVA和回归模型检验假设
AI.findings: 1. 产业集群中的企业绩效优于其他区位企业；2. 区位本身不保证卓越绩效；3. 创新性增强盈利能力，尤其在产业集群中；4. 孤立企业更依赖效率驱动策略；5. 交互效应较弱，反映数据不平衡和区位-创新联系的偶然性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了拉丁美洲首个系统分析集聚类型与创新性对企业绩效影响的研究；2. 细化了产业集群、城市集聚区和孤立地区的区别；3. 将创新性概念化为机构薄弱环境中的动态能力
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 管理者应采用创新导向的商业模式以利用集聚效益；2. 政策制定者需设计针对不同区位类型（产业集群、城市集聚区、孤立地区）的差异化政策工具；3. 支持主要集聚区外的创新企业可促进区域发展和减少不平等

title: The Role of Digital Transformation in Exchange Rate Regime Choice: Evidence from Developed and Emerging Countries

detail.title: The Role of Digital Transformation in Exchange Rate Regime Choice: Evidence from Developed and Emerging Countries
detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of digitalization as a determinant of exchange rate regime choice. This role remains unexplored in literature, thereby constituting a major research gap. Using an unbalanced panel dataset of 98 countries covering the period 1990-2024, we estimate ordered probit model to assess how digital development influences the likelihood of adopting fixed, intermediate, or flexible exchange rate regimes. The results indicate that countries with higher levels of digitalization are more likely to adopt more flexible exchange rate regimes. This outcome reflects the fact that digitalization enhances information flows, market efficiency, and monetary policy transmission, thereby increasing the capacity of economies to absorb external shocks under flexible exchange rate arrangements. The findings further reveal important heterogeneities between developed and emerging economies, with digitalization playing a stronger role in supporting exchange rate flexibility in advanced economies, while institutional and macroeconomic constraints limit its effect in emerging countries. Overall, the results highlight digitalization as a structural factor shaping exchange rate regime choices and providing new insights into the interaction between technological development and monetary policy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨数字化如何影响汇率制度选择，发现数字化水平高的国家更倾向于采用灵活汇率制度，这一效应在发达经济体更强。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何影响各国汇率制度选择？数字化水平是否使国家更倾向于采用灵活汇率制度？
AI.motivation: 现有文献尚未探讨数字化对汇率制度选择的影响，构成重要研究空白。随着数字技术快速发展，理解数字化如何重塑货币政策框架具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和货币政策理论，数字化通过改善信息流动、市场效率和货币政策传导机制，增强经济体在灵活汇率制度下吸收外部冲击的能力。
AI.method: 使用1990-2024年98个国家的非平衡面板数据，采用有序probit模型评估数字化发展对采用固定、中间或灵活汇率制度可能性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 数字化水平高的国家更可能采用灵活汇率制度；2. 数字化通过增强信息流动、市场效率和货币政策传导发挥作用；3. 发达与新兴经济体存在异质性：数字化对发达经济体支持汇率灵活性的作用更强，新兴经济体受制度和宏观经济约束限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将数字化作为汇率制度选择的结构性决定因素；2. 拓展了技术发展与货币政策框架互动的理论理解；3. 为汇率制度选择理论提供了新的数字化视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供数字化时代汇率制度选择的决策参考；2. 帮助新兴经济体识别数字化进程中面临的制度约束；3. 为国际货币体系改革提供数字化维度的政策启示。

title: Who Captures AI Deflation? Quality-Adjusted Prices, Markups, and Pass-Through in AI Services
affiliations: University of Warwick - Warwick Business School

detail.title: Who Captures AI Deflation? Quality-Adjusted Prices, Markups, and Pass-Through in AI Services
detail.abstract: AI inference costs are falling rapidly, yet how much of this deflation reaches down-stream firms depends on market structure. I construct the first constant-quality price index for AI services and show that, once quality improvement is accounted for, effective AI prices fell by approximately 78 percent from early 2024 through early 2026, roughly twice the nominal price decline. To disentangle cost from market power, I estimate a structural demand system using model-level token usage data from OpenRouter, a centralized API marketplace, and recover provider-level markups. The AI services market is oligopolistic, and markups meaningfully moderate cost transmission: GPU cost pass-through is positive and significant, but higher-markup providers absorb a disproportionately larger share of upstream cost declines. Embedding the quality-adjusted price index in an input-output framework, I find a roughly 120 basis points cumulative deflationary contribution to the PPI over the same period, with indirect supply-chain linkages accounting for the majority of the aggregate effect. A welfare decomposition reveals that the entry of new, higher-capability models, not price reductions on existing ones, accounts for the substantial majority of consumer surplus gains.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了首个AI服务的恒定质量价格指数，发现2024年初至2026年初AI有效价格下降约78%（考虑质量改进后），是名义价格降幅的两倍。研究显示AI服务市场呈寡头垄断结构，高利润率供应商吸收更多上游成本下降，导致成本传导不完全。AI价格下降对PPI产生约120个基点的通缩贡献，且消费者剩余增长主要来自新模型进入而非现有模型降价。
AI.research_question: AI服务价格下降如何受市场结构影响？成本下降在多大程度上传递给下游企业？AI价格下降对整体经济通胀有何影响？消费者福利增长主要来自价格下降还是质量改进？
AI.motivation: AI推理成本快速下降，但这些成本下降如何传递给下游企业取决于市场结构。现有研究缺乏对AI服务质量的调整，难以准确衡量实际价格变化和市场力量的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业组织理论中的寡头垄断模型、价格指数理论（恒定质量调整）、成本传导理论、投入产出框架、消费者剩余分解分析。
AI.method: 1. 构建首个AI服务恒定质量价格指数；2. 使用OpenRouter API市场的模型级token使用数据进行结构需求系统估计；3. 估计供应商级利润率；4. 将质量调整价格指数嵌入投入产出框架分析宏观影响；5. 进行福利分解分析。
AI.findings: 1. 2024-2026年AI有效价格下降78%（质量调整后），是名义降幅的两倍；2. AI服务市场呈寡头垄断结构；3. 高利润率供应商吸收更多上游成本下降，GPU成本传导为正但受利润率调节；4. AI价格下降对PPI产生约120个基点的通缩贡献，主要通过供应链间接联系；5. 消费者剩余增长主要来自新模型进入而非现有模型降价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了首个AI服务恒定质量价格指数方法；2. 揭示了寡头垄断市场中成本传导的异质性；3. 提供了AI技术扩散对宏观经济影响的量化框架；4. 区分了价格下降和质量改进对消费者福利的不同贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI价格下降对通胀影响的量化评估；2. 帮助企业理解AI服务市场的竞争动态和定价策略；3. 为投资者提供AI产业利润分配和成本传导的洞察；4. 为监管机构识别市场力量对技术扩散的影响提供依据。

title: Explainable and Calibrated Machine Learning Models for Probability of Default: An application to Expected Credit Loss under IFRS 9

detail.title: Explainable and Calibrated Machine Learning Models for Probability of Default: An application to Expected Credit Loss under IFRS 9
detail.abstract: An excessive Non-performing loan (NPL) rate exposes the Bangladesh banking sector to high default risk. In particular, accurately assessing loan classification as good or bad and maintaining loan loss provisions for loans are the cornerstones of credit risk assessment. A major policy shift is being undertaken from the present Hybrid Model under "IAS 39" and Rule-Based to "Expected Credit Loss" (ECL) under International Financial Reporting Standard 9 (IFRS 9). To calculate future losses on loans, the ECL requires a probability of Default (PD) estimate. This study focuses on advanced Machine Learning (ML)-based ECL-PD models addressing domestic challenges related to data imbalance, governance, and model explainability and validation. Using a dataset of 32,581 observations of retail loans, 12 ML algorithms were applied and evaluated under an ML workflow. Class imbalance was addressed by adopting the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Post-model calibration methods were applied to enhance the reliability of PDs, adopting Platt Scaling and Isotonic Regression. A lower Brier Score of 0.0535 for Isotonic indicates better calibration performance over Platt Scaling. This analysis adopts the Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) and Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME). The outcomes of models indicate that ensemble methods are better performers than traditional Logistic Regression in non-linear and complex datasets. The Gini score of 0.897 and the AUC-ROC of 0.949 for the XGBClassifier reflect its strong ability in classification and prediction. Moreover, the Population Stability Index (PSI) shows model stability. This analysis focuses particularly on the calibrated PD estimate for ECL and the assessment of Significant Increase in Credit Risk (SICR) for staging decisions under IFRS 9. In the backdrop of Bangladesh Bank's Roadmap towards the implementation of IFRS 9, this framework provides a pragmatic pathway for transitioning from a rule-based classification and provisioning method to a forward-looking ECL approach.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了基于机器学习的预期信用损失概率违约模型，用于孟加拉国银行业从IAS 39混合模型向IFRS 9 ECL方法的转型，通过SMOTE处理数据不平衡，采用校准技术提高PD可靠性，使用SHAP和LIME增强模型可解释性，XGBoost模型表现最佳。
AI.research_question: 如何开发有效的机器学习模型来估计预期信用损失的概率违约，以支持孟加拉国银行业从IAS 39向IFRS 9的转型？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国银行业面临高不良贷款率带来的违约风险，需要从现行的IAS 39混合模型和规则基础方法转向IFRS 9的预期信用损失方法，但面临数据不平衡、治理和模型可解释性等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际财务报告准则9（IFRS 9）的预期信用损失框架、信用风险评估理论、机器学习分类算法理论、模型校准理论、可解释人工智能理论。
AI.method: 使用32,581个零售贷款观测数据集，应用12种机器学习算法，采用SMOTE处理类别不平衡，使用Platt Scaling和Isotonic Regression进行模型校准，采用SHAP和LIME进行模型解释，评估指标包括Brier Score、Gini分数、AUC-ROC和PSI。
AI.findings: 集成方法在非线性复杂数据集上优于传统逻辑回归；XGBClassifier的Gini分数为0.897，AUC-ROC为0.949，分类预测能力强；Isotonic Regression的Brier Score为0.0535，校准性能优于Platt Scaling；模型通过PSI验证具有稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为IFRS 9 ECL框架提供了机器学习方法论的实证支持；发展了处理银行业数据不平衡问题的技术方案；推进了信用风险模型校准和可解释性研究的理论进展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国银行业提供了从规则基础方法向预期信用损失方法转型的实用框架；开发了可用于实际PD估计和SICR评估的机器学习模型；支持孟加拉国银行IFRS 9实施路线图的落地。

title: Housing Costs, Parental Resources, and Declining Male Labor Force Participation

detail.title: Housing Costs, Parental Resources, and Declining Male Labor Force Participation
detail.abstract: Prime-aged male labor force participation in the U.S. has declined substantially over the past sixty years, with the sharpest falls among men without a college degree. Over the same period, the share of men living with parents has doubled. I develop a dynamic lifecycle model in which young men make employment and coresidence decisions. The parental home serves as a consumption floor that reduces the returns to working, and rising housing costs make this fallback increasingly valuable relative to low-wage employment. Using geographic variation in housing supply constraints as an instrument, I provide reduced-form evidence consistent with rising rents significantly increasing parental coresidence and reducing labor force participation among low-earning men, validating the central channel of the model. The model decomposes six decades of participation decline into contributions from falling labor demand, rising housing costs, and increased parental resources. Estimation is in progress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国中年男性劳动力参与率下降与与父母同住比例上升的关系，发现住房成本上升通过增加父母家庭作为消费保障的价值，降低了低薪男性的工作激励。
AI.research_question: 住房成本上升如何通过影响与父母同住决策，进而导致美国中年男性劳动力参与率下降？
AI.motivation: 过去60年美国中年男性劳动力参与率显著下降，特别是无大学学历男性；同期与父母同住的男性比例翻倍。需要理解这两个趋势之间的联系机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态生命周期模型：年轻男性在就业和与父母同住之间做决策；父母家庭作为消费保障，降低了工作的边际收益；住房成本上升使这种保障相对于低薪工作更有价值。
AI.method: 1. 使用地理差异的住房供给约束作为工具变量；2. 提供简约形式的证据，证明租金上涨显著增加与父母同住并降低劳动力参与；3. 建立动态生命周期模型进行分解分析。
AI.findings: 1. 租金上涨显著增加低薪男性与父母同住比例；2. 租金上涨降低低薪男性劳动力参与率；3. 验证了模型的核心机制：住房成本通过父母家庭作为消费保障影响就业决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了连接住房市场、家庭结构和劳动力供给的统一理论框架；2. 解释了父母家庭作为消费保障如何影响就业激励；3. 提供了理解长期劳动力参与下降的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解劳动力参与下降提供机制解释；2. 指出住房政策可能影响劳动力市场结果；3. 帮助设计针对低薪男性的就业激励政策。

title: The Phygital Frontier: A Conceptual Framework for Enhancing Customer Experience through IoT Innovations
affiliations: , Princess Nourah Bint Abdulrahman University, Amity University Uttar Pradesh and IMS, University of Lucknow

detail.title: The Phygital Frontier: A Conceptual Framework for Enhancing Customer Experience through IoT Innovations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We the authors, declare no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. No funding was received for conducting this study. The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose. This research is a perspective; thus, it involves no human participants or animal subjects. However, the research ethics from the conceptualization of the research domain to the final draft of the study, there has been complete integrity among the authors as well as total ethical journal throughout the research.

detail.abstract: As business models undergo a decisive shift, sellers are increasingly prioritizing customer experiences to meet a growing demand for interactions that feel emotionally resonant and meaningful. The customers are expecting that the interactions must remain unified. The Internet of Things (IoT) emerges as a transformative force designing customer interactions and business operations. Scholarly understanding of how IoT capabilities enhance customer experience (CX) remains highly fragmented. This chapter addresses this conceptual gap with a structured and original framework. It proposes the CX IoT Value Matrix. Four mechanisms link technology to outcomes. Experiential outcomes become measurable. Framework guidance appears clear. Contextual sensing captures real-time environmental information, enabling situationally appropriate responses. Predictive personalization anticipates individual needs before customers articulate them explicitly. Seamless interaction eliminates friction across physical and digital touchpoints continuously. Proactive resolution prevents problems rather than merely remediating failures after occurrence. The framework is illustrated through three corporate cases spanning retail, automotive, and athletic wear sectors. Amazon demonstrates ecosystem-wide integration of all four mechanisms. Tesla demonstrates proactive resolution in connected-vehicle environments. Nike exemplifies predictive personalization throughout digital and physical engagement. The chapter offers theoretical advancement for customer journey and service-dominant logic scholarship. It provides practitioners with diagnostic tools to guide strategic technology investment decisions effectively. Ethical considerations regarding privacy, security, and inclusion receive careful attention throughout the discussion. Future research directions emerge clearly from identified limitations and unexplored areas. The framework serves as a foundation for subsequent empirical studies and practical applications. It supports both theory and practice. Guidance becomes actionable. Research gaps become visible. Practical implementation benefits follow. Ethical issues remain central.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为"CX IoT价值矩阵"的框架，通过四种机制（情境感知、预测性个性化、无缝交互、主动解决）将物联网能力与客户体验提升联系起来，并用三个企业案例进行说明。
AI.research_question: 物联网能力如何增强客户体验？
AI.motivation: 随着商业模式转变，企业越来越重视客户体验，物联网成为设计客户交互和业务运营的变革力量，但学术界对物联网如何增强客户体验的理解仍然高度碎片化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户旅程理论、服务主导逻辑、CX IoT价值矩阵框架（包含四种机制：情境感知、预测性个性化、无缝交互、主动解决）
AI.method: 概念框架开发，通过三个企业案例进行说明：亚马逊（生态系统整合）、特斯拉（主动解决）、耐克（预测性个性化）
AI.findings: 物联网通过四种机制增强客户体验：情境感知捕获实时环境信息；预测性个性化在客户明确表达前预测需求；无缝交互消除物理和数字接触点的摩擦；主动解决问题而非事后补救。
AI.theory_contributions: 对客户旅程和服务主导逻辑研究做出理论推进，为后续实证研究提供基础框架，使研究空白变得可见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供诊断工具以指导战略技术投资决策，使指导变得可操作，带来实际实施效益，同时关注隐私、安全和包容等伦理问题。

title: Integrated Analysis of Literacy to Judge the Veracity of Information and Understand Dissemination Behavior
affiliations: and International University of Japan

detail.title: Integrated Analysis of Literacy to Judge the Veracity of Information and Understand Dissemination Behavior

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JST Moonshot R&D Grant Number JPMJMS2215 and JST RISTEX Japan Grant Number JPMJRS23L2.

detail.abstract: Purpose: This study examines how different forms of literacy and psychological factors are associated with individuals' veracity judgments and sharing behavior concerning both political misinformation and true information in Japan. Design/methodology/approach: We conducted a large-scale online survey using a national panel (main survey n = 15,261), presenting 10 widely circulated political misinformation items and 10 true news items. We measured media, digital, fact-opinion, fact-checking, and political literacies, as well as confidence in veracity judgments and key psychological variables. Using item-level panel data and logit models with information-item fixed effects, we estimated the determinants of correct veracity judgments and sharing behaviors for misinformation and true information. Findings: Higher media literacy was associated with better recognition of misinformation as false, whereas higher digital, fact-opinion, and political literacies were linked to a greater tendency to believe information regardless of its truth status. Understanding fact-checking methods and confidence in one's judgments were positively associated with belief in true news. Across both information types, higher literacies generally reduced sharing, whereas the desire for attention and political interest increased sharing. Originality: By jointly analyzing multiple literacies, psychological factors, veracity judgments, and the sharing of both misinformation and true information, this study clarifies which literacies function as effective countermeasures to the spread of political misinformation. It also highlights the ambivalent role of some literacies that support belief in true information while failing to improve, or even weaken, the detection of misinformation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模在线调查，探讨了多种素养（媒体、数字、事实-观点、事实核查、政治素养）和心理因素如何影响日本民众对政治虚假信息和真实信息的真实性判断及分享行为。
AI.research_question: 不同形式的素养和心理因素如何影响个人对政治虚假信息和真实信息的真实性判断及分享行为？
AI.motivation: 理解哪些素养能有效对抗政治虚假信息的传播，同时揭示某些素养在支持真实信息信念的同时可能无法改善甚至削弱虚假信息检测能力的矛盾作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多种素养理论（媒体素养、数字素养、事实-观点区分素养、事实核查素养、政治素养）和心理因素（判断自信度、关注需求、政治兴趣）对信息处理行为的影响框架。
AI.method: 使用全国面板进行大规模在线调查（主调查n=15,261），呈现10个广泛传播的政治虚假信息项目和10个真实新闻项目。采用项目级面板数据和带有信息项目固定效应的logit模型，估计正确真实性判断和分享行为的决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 较高的媒体素养与更好地识别虚假信息为假相关；2. 较高的数字、事实-观点和政治素养与更倾向于相信信息（无论其真实性）相关；3. 理解事实核查方法和判断自信度与相信真实新闻正相关；4. 较高的素养通常减少分享行为，而关注需求和政治兴趣增加分享行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过联合分析多种素养、心理因素、真实性判断以及虚假信息和真实信息的分享行为，阐明了哪些素养能有效对抗政治虚假信息的传播，并揭示了某些素养在支持真实信息信念的同时可能无法改善甚至削弱虚假信息检测能力的矛盾作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和教育工作者提供了关于哪些素养培训最有效对抗虚假信息传播的实证依据，同时警示某些素养可能产生的意外负面效果，有助于设计更精准的媒体素养教育项目。

title: When Mass Security Screening Backfires: Causal Modeling for Complex Equilibrium Systems

detail.title: When Mass Security Screening Backfires: Causal Modeling for Complex Equilibrium Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no financial conflicts of interest. The author previously conducted FOIA litigation against U.S. federal agencies regarding polygraph programs, which is disclosed in the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data (LEMAS 2003, ICPSR 4411; LEMAS 2007, ICPSR 31161) and does not involve human subjects research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding.

detail.abstract:
Mass security screening programs — from police polygraph testing to AI surveillance of digital communications — share an identical mathematical structure as signal detection problems under conditions of rarity, persistent uncertainty, and secondary screening harms. Standard policy analysis focuses on a single causal pathway: classification accuracy. But causal modeling reveals three additional pathways through which such programs may affect outcomes: strategic behavior (deterrence, evasion, selection), information effects (elicitation, bogus pipeline, iatrogenesis), and resource reallocation (zero-sum capacity constraints, framing effects). Net effects cannot be estimated from classification accuracy analysis alone.

This paper develops a four-pathway equilibrium framework using directed cyclic graphs and structural equations following Besserve and Schölkopf (2022), and begins to apply it to three cases. For EU Chat Control 2.0 (proposed mandatory AI scanning of all digital communications, including end-to-end encrypted, for unknown CSAM), all four pathways converge on net harm: Bayesian analysis yields 99.4% false positive rates under favorable assumptions, dedicated-offender evasion dominates casual-offender deterrence by a factor of 46.6 across the full parameter space, the information pathway is architecturally absent, and false positive volume overwhelms investigative capacity at every institutional layer. For police polygraph programs, a difference-in-differences analysis of LEMAS 2003–2007 data using negative binomial regression produces inconclusive results (IRR = 2.4, 95% CI 1.17–4.97 for total complaints; N ≈ 33), consistent with net uncertainty; simulation predicts modest net benefit via the information pathway contingent on laboratory bogus pipeline effects transporting to operational settings. For iBorderCtrl, weak information pathway coupling and absent accuracy validation suggest net harm, consistent with its abandonment after scientific critique.

The framework identifies a structural regularity across security, medical, and information integrity domains and argues for legislative rather than case-by-case responses to programs sharing this dangerous mathematical form.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个四路径均衡框架来分析大规模安全筛查项目，指出仅关注分类准确性是不够的，必须同时考虑战略行为、信息效应和资源再分配三个额外路径。通过欧盟聊天控制2.0、警察测谎仪和iBorderCtrl三个案例验证了框架的有效性，发现这些项目通常导致净危害而非净效益。
AI.research_question: 大规模安全筛查项目（如AI监控、测谎测试）在稀有性、持续不确定性和二次筛查危害条件下，如何通过四个因果路径影响最终结果？
AI.motivation: 传统政策分析仅关注分类准确性这一单一因果路径，忽视了战略行为、信息效应和资源再分配三个重要路径，导致对大规模安全筛查项目净效应的评估存在严重偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Besserve和Schölkopf（2022）的有向循环图和结构方程，构建四路径均衡框架，包括：1）分类准确性路径；2）战略行为路径（威慑、规避、选择）；3）信息效应路径（诱导、虚假管道、医源性效应）；4）资源再分配路径（零和能力约束、框架效应）。
AI.method: 采用多方法研究设计：1）贝叶斯分析（欧盟聊天控制2.0案例）；2）双重差分法结合负二项回归（警察测谎仪案例，使用LEMAS 2003-2007数据）；3）模拟分析；4）案例研究比较分析。
AI.findings: 1）欧盟聊天控制2.0：四个路径均指向净危害（99.4%误报率，规避效应是威慑效应的46.6倍，信息路径缺失，误报量压倒调查能力）；2）警察测谎仪：结果不确定（总投诉IRR=2.4，95% CI 1.17-4.97），模拟显示信息路径可能带来适度净效益；3）iBorderCtrl：信息路径耦合弱且缺乏准确性验证，导致净危害。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出统一的分析框架，识别安全、医疗和信息完整性领域的结构规律性；2）扩展了信号检测理论，纳入行为反应和制度约束；3）为政策评估提供更全面的因果分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）揭示大规模筛查项目通常导致净危害而非净效益；2）为政策制定者提供评估工具，避免仅依赖分类准确性；3）主张立法而非个案回应的政策应对策略；4）为具体项目（如欧盟聊天控制2.0）提供实证反对依据。

title: Agentic Agent, Better Agent: Evidence from Agentic AI in Telemarketing
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business, , Chongqing University, Chongqing University and University of Washington - Michael G. Foster School of Business

detail.title: Agentic Agent, Better Agent: Evidence from Agentic AI in Telemarketing
detail.abstract: Large language models are increasingly being deployed as agentic AI systems that autonomously manage customer interactions, yet their effectiveness in persuasion-intensive telemarketing settings remains largely unknown. We examine whether agentic AI can become a better agent in outbound financial telemarketing through a collaboration with a leading Chinese FinTech firm. The firm deployed three telemarketing agent types in parallel: human agents, a standard LLM-based agentic AI system, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system grounded in verified internal knowledge. Using a quasi-experimental design and 7.41 million unique customer interactions, we find that standard agentic AI increases the odds of same-day loan initiation by 96.0% relative to human agents, while RAG-enhanced agentic AI increases those odds by 213.9%. RAG-enhanced agentic AI also outperforms the standard system by 39.8%, highlighting the value of grounding agentic AI in verified organizational knowledge. To understand why agentic AI performs so effectively in this context, we draw on the competence-warmth framework to examine the underlying mechanisms. The evidence suggests that agentic AI delivers both greater warmth, reflected in a more positive and more stable emotional tone, and greater competence, reflected in the superior performance of the RAG-enhanced agentic AI, stronger effects among competence-sensitive customers, and a widening AI advantage as human agents accumulate working hours. Although the AI advantage attenuates among customers more likely to recognize the AI identity, it remains economically substantial relative to human agents, suggesting that the effectiveness of agentic AI is robust to AI identity detection. These findings show that agentic AI can outperform human agents in trust-dependent financial sales and demonstrate the business value of retrieval augmentation in customer-facing agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过与一家领先的中国金融科技公司合作，探讨了在金融电话营销中，代理式AI能否比人类代理更有效。研究发现，标准代理式AI将当日贷款启动几率提高了96%，而基于检索增强生成（RAG）的AI则提高了213.9%。RAG增强的AI比标准系统表现更好39.8%。研究使用能力-温暖框架解释AI的优势，发现AI在情感温暖和业务能力方面都优于人类代理。
AI.research_question: 代理式AI能否在信任依赖的金融销售（特别是外呼金融电话营销）中比人类代理表现更好？检索增强生成（RAG）技术如何进一步提升代理式AI的销售效果？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署为自主管理客户互动的代理式AI系统，但它们在说服密集型电话营销环境中的有效性仍然很大程度上未知。特别是在金融销售这种高度依赖信任的领域，AI代理的表现需要实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力-温暖框架（competence-warmth framework）：用于解释代理式AI为何在金融电话营销中表现优越。温暖维度体现在情感语调的积极性和稳定性，能力维度体现在RAG增强系统的优越性能、对能力敏感客户的更强效果，以及随着人类代理工作时间积累而扩大的AI优势。
AI.method: 准实验设计，与一家领先的中国金融科技公司合作。公司并行部署了三种电话营销代理类型：人类代理、标准LLM基础的代理式AI系统、基于已验证内部知识的检索增强生成（RAG）系统。分析了741万次独特的客户互动数据。
AI.findings: 1. 标准代理式AI将当日贷款启动几率相对于人类代理提高了96.0%；2. RAG增强的代理式AI将几率提高了213.9%；3. RAG增强的AI比标准系统表现更好39.8%；4. AI在温暖（更积极稳定的情感语调）和能力（RAG系统优越性能）两方面都优于人类；5. AI优势在更可能识别AI身份的客户中有所减弱，但仍保持经济显著性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在信任依赖的金融销售环境中实证验证代理式AI相对于人类代理的优越性；2. 应用能力-温暖框架解释AI在销售中的成功机制；3. 展示了检索增强生成技术在客户面向代理系统中的理论价值；4. 为AI身份识别对销售效果的影响提供了新的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融科技公司提供了部署代理式AI电话营销系统的实证依据；2. 展示了RAG技术在提升AI销售效果方面的实际商业价值；3. 为企业如何通过知识增强提升AI代理能力提供了操作指南；4. 为AI在敏感金融销售场景中的应用提供了实践参考。

title: Security Without Accountability: The LAG Framework for Web 3.0 Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Security Without Accountability: The LAG Framework for Web 3.0 Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent researcher and declares no competing financial interests, advisory roles, or organizational affiliations related to the blockchain systems discussed in this study. No external funding was received for this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, interviews, surveys, or private data. All information analyzed was obtained from publicly available sources. Ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no financial support from any public, private, or nonprofit funding source.

keywords: ex ante and ex post security

detail.abstract: Decentralized and autonomous systems associated with Web 3.0 challenge long-standing assumptions about security governance, responsibility, and control. Although advances in cryptography, consensus mechanisms, and automation have strengthened technical protections, they have also fragmented accountability across software agents, organizations, and ecosystems, producing security failures in environments where responsibility for prevention, response, and remediation is unclear or contested. This paper demonstrates that many such failures stem not from inadequate technical safeguards but from governance gaps created by sociotechnical complexity. Drawing on sociotechnical systems theory, it introduces the LAG (Layers-Accountability-Governance) framework, which distinguishes among information technology security, information security, and enterprise-level governance, and clarifies the misalignment between ex ante preventive mechanisms and ex post response and recovery processes. Through analysis of decentralized architectures, autonomous agents, and machine identities, and case studies of the DAO, Poly Network, and oracle-related failures, the paper shows how technically correct system behavior can nonetheless produce governance failure and discusses implications for the design and governance of secure systems in complex digital ecosystems where traditional organizational boundaries no longer apply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAG框架，分析Web 3.0去中心化系统中技术正确但治理失败的安全问题，强调社会技术复杂性导致的治理缺口而非技术缺陷
AI.research_question: 去中心化自治系统如何解决技术正确但治理失败的安全问题？社会技术复杂性如何导致治理缺口？
AI.motivation: Web 3.0的去中心化和自治系统挑战了传统安全治理、责任和控制假设，虽然加密、共识机制和自动化技术加强了技术保护，但也导致责任分散，在预防、响应和修复责任不明确的环境中产生安全失败
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论，LAG（层次-责任-治理）框架，区分信息技术安全、信息安全和企业级治理，澄清事前预防机制与事后响应恢复过程的错配
AI.method: 通过分析去中心化架构、自治代理和机器身份，以及对DAO、Poly Network和预言机相关失败的案例研究
AI.findings: 许多安全失败源于社会技术复杂性造成的治理缺口而非技术保障不足；技术正确的系统行为仍可能导致治理失败；传统组织边界在复杂数字生态系统中不再适用
AI.theory_contributions: 提出LAG框架，系统分析去中心化系统中的治理层次和责任分配；扩展社会技术系统理论在Web 3.0安全治理中的应用；澄清技术安全与治理安全的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂数字生态系统中的安全系统设计和治理提供指导；帮助识别和解决治理缺口；为去中心化系统的责任分配和响应机制设计提供实践建议

reference: SAFE Working Paper No. 474
title: Public Discourse on Retail Payments and the Case of CBDC

detail.title: Public Discourse on Retail Payments and the Case of CBDC

publicationDetails.journalName: Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: The retail payment industry is significant, affects every citizen and is a very precondition for a modern society based on the division of labor. It is also unique in many respects: two-sidedness, strong network effects, high fixed costs, high concentration and high profitability of successful firms, layering, path dependencies and potential stability of inferior equilibria. Alternative retail payment architectures may have potentially relatively similar social welfare performances, but vastly different implications on different industry stakeholders. While in any industry, key stakeholders aim at influencing public opinion and ultimately also legislation by spreading public narratives which are favorable from their perspective, the specificities of the retail payment industry accentuate the incentives to influence public opinion and lawmakers, including through "alternative" narratives. The public discourse on retail payment architecture will be confusing for several reasons: (i) technical complexity of retail payment architectures for non-experts; (ii) expertise concentrated with those having vested interests and who will thus provide tactically biased explanations and opinion; (iii) significant financial fire power of successful incumbent firms to promote their narratives; (iv) incentives to promote projects "out of the money" with exaggerated arguments, while truly promising projects may be kept secret for long; (v) long deployment times and uncertainty on ultimate implementation and use. We discuss the various perspectives of key retail payment industry stakeholders. For each, identify their main interest, key preferred narratives, and feared narratives. We discuss in more depth specific issues relating to the narratives and design of retail CBDC. We draw lessons from a public policy perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了零售支付行业的特殊性及其对公共政策的影响，探讨了不同利益相关者的立场、叙事策略，并特别关注了央行数字货币的设计与公共政策启示。
AI.research_question: 零售支付行业的特殊性如何影响不同利益相关者的叙事策略，以及这对央行数字货币设计和公共政策有何启示？
AI.motivation: 零售支付行业对社会至关重要且具有独特性（双边市场、网络效应、高固定成本等），不同支付架构对利益相关者影响差异巨大，导致各方积极通过叙事影响公共舆论和政策制定，这种复杂性需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于产业组织理论（特别是双边市场、网络效应）、制度经济学（路径依赖）、公共政策分析、叙事经济学和利益相关者理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过识别关键利益相关者（如央行、商业银行、科技公司、消费者等），分析各自的利益诉求、偏好的叙事和被抵制的叙事，特别深入探讨CBDC相关议题。
AI.findings: 1. 零售支付行业存在强烈的叙事竞争，各方基于自身利益塑造公共话语；2. 技术复杂性、专家偏见、资金实力等因素使公共讨论混乱；3. 不同利益相关者（如现有银行与金融科技公司）的叙事策略存在系统性差异；4. CBDC设计涉及复杂的权衡，需要平衡创新、稳定、隐私等多重目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将叙事经济学应用于零售支付政策分析，提出了一个分析支付行业利益相关者叙事策略的框架，丰富了关于制度变迁中话语权竞争的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别和评估支付行业不同叙事背后利益动机的工具，有助于设计更稳健的CBDC框架，提升支付系统公共决策的质量和透明度。

title: When AI Writes, Who Is the Author? Authorship as Governance in Generative AI

detail.title: When AI Writes, Who Is the Author? Authorship as Governance in Generative AI
detail.abstract: Debates over generative AI often ask whether texts produced with large language models are "really" authored by the human user. These debates typically assume that authorship resides in the production of linguistic tokens. This paper challenges that assumption by reconceptualizing AI-assisted writing as a structured, iterative process rather than a discrete act of generation. I introduce the concept of Corrigible Judgment Execution (CJE) to describe how human agents orient communicative purposes, solicit probabilistic proposals from generative systems, evaluate outputs against normative and strategic criteria, impose constraints, and determine convergence. Drawing on the concept of entropy from information theory, I argue that generative models operate within high-uncertainty possibility spaces, producing text that is semantically plausible but purposeless until embedded within governed processes of constraint and ratification. Meaningful communication emerges not from the elimination of stochasticity but from its disciplined reduction. Authorship, therefore, cannot coherently be located in token production. It consists in the sustained authority to govern the reduction of communicative entropy and to ratify convergence under conditions of accountability. By relocating authorship from inscription to governance, this account clarifies responsibility in human-AI co-production and situates AI-assisted writing within broader sociological debates about agency, expertise, and automation.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统将AI辅助写作视为离散生成过程的观点，提出应将AI辅助写作重新概念化为结构化、迭代的过程，并引入"可修正判断执行"框架来解释人类如何通过约束和批准来治理AI生成文本的熵减过程。
AI.research_question: 在AI辅助写作中，作者身份究竟存在于何处？是存在于语言标记的生产中，还是存在于对沟通熵减过程的治理和批准中？
AI.motivation: 当前关于生成式AI的辩论往往假设作者身份存在于语言标记的生产中，这种假设过于简化了AI辅助写作的实际过程，需要更精细的理论框架来理解人类与AI协作中的作者身份和责任归属。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 可修正判断执行(CJE)框架；2. 信息论中的熵概念；3. 作者身份作为治理过程而非标记生产的理论；4. 沟通熵减的纪律性减少理论。
AI.method: 概念分析/理论建构方法，通过引入信息论概念（熵）和构建CJE框架，对AI辅助写作过程进行理论重构。
AI.findings: 1. 生成模型在高不确定性可能性空间中运作，产生语义上合理但无目的性的文本；2. 有意义的沟通不是通过消除随机性，而是通过其纪律性减少而出现；3. 作者身份不能连贯地定位于标记生产，而在于治理沟通熵减和批准收敛的持续权威。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将作者身份从铭刻重新定位到治理；2. 为理解人类-AI协作中的责任提供了清晰的理论框架；3. 将AI辅助写作置于更广泛的社会学辩论中，涉及代理、专业知识和自动化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 澄清了人类-AI协作中的责任归属；2. 为AI辅助写作工具的设计提供了理论指导；3. 为评估AI生成内容的质量和可信度提供了新视角。

title: Testing Moral Development in AI: An Experimental Architecture for Internal Value Development in AI Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Testing Moral Development in AI: An Experimental Architecture for Internal Value Development in AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This paper presents a complete empirical verification architecture for the Internal Value Development (IVD) framework proposed in the companion paper 'Beyond External Constraints: The Missing Dimension of AI Governance' (SSRN, 2026). While the parent paper establishes the theoretical case for AI internal value development, this paper addresses a direct question: how to test whether it works. The design centers on three components. First, a model architecture that separates base language capability from moral judgment by attaching a small trainable value module to a frozen pretrained model, ensuring all moral development is isolated and traceable. Second, a daytime-sleep internalization mechanism, grounded in Walker and Stickgold's (2004) memory consolidation research, in which experiential reflections generated during simulated moral interactions are consolidated into the module's weights and then the reflection buffer is cleared, providing a direct test of whether internalization has occurred. Third, a three-layer consequence-driven evaluation framework that assesses not what the model says but what its actions cause within a simulated social environment. The paper defines functional internalization as its core operational concept and proposes a four-level outcome spectrum, ensuring that every possible result, including negative findings, yields a substantive contribution to AI moral capability research.

AI.tldr: 本文为IVD框架提供实证验证架构，通过分离道德模块、日间睡眠内化机制和三层结果驱动评估，测试AI内部价值发展的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何测试内部价值发展（IVD）框架是否有效？
AI.motivation: 虽然配套论文建立了AI内部价值发展的理论基础，但缺乏实证验证方法。本文旨在解决如何实际测试IVD框架是否有效的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 内部价值发展（IVD）框架；2. Walker和Stickgold（2004）的记忆巩固理论；3. 功能内化作为核心操作概念；4. 四层结果谱系理论。
AI.method: 1. 分离式模型架构：将基础语言能力与道德判断分离，附加可训练价值模块到冻结的预训练模型；2. 日间睡眠内化机制：基于记忆巩固理论，将模拟道德互动中的经验反思整合到模块权重中；3. 三层结果驱动评估框架：在模拟社会环境中评估模型行动的实际后果而非其言论。
AI.findings: 本文提出完整的验证架构，但未报告具体实证结果。架构设计确保所有可能结果（包括负面发现）都能对AI道德能力研究做出实质性贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将IVD理论框架转化为可测试的实证架构；2. 提出功能内化的操作化定义；3. 建立四层结果谱系理论框架；4. 将认知科学中的记忆巩固理论应用于AI道德发展研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可实施的AI内部价值发展测试方法；2. 开发可追踪、可解释的道德模块架构；3. 建立系统化的评估框架；4. 为AI治理和道德能力研究提供实证工具。

title: Temporal Sovereignty and Systemic Augmented Intelligence: Rebuilding Institutional Authority in the Era of Continuous Execution and Quantum Decryption
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Temporal Sovereignty and Systemic Augmented Intelligence: Rebuilding Institutional Authority in the Era of Continuous Execution and Quantum Decryption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the CEO and founder of Essência A.I. Ltda. The present work is an independent academic contribution and did not receive external influence or sponsorship that could have affected its conceptual development.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual and theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The convergence of continuous algorithmic execution and the anticipated impact of quantum decryption challenge the temporal assumptions underlying institutional governance. Current frameworks rely on episodic oversight, creating a structural cadence asymmetry when applied to systems that operate uninterruptedly. This temporal misalignment may generate what this paper defines as "epistemic drift," wherein active human judgment is quietly replaced by the passive validation of machine outputs. The systemic risk is magnified by the Harvest Now, Decrypt Later (HNDL) paradigm, which transcends traditional cybersecurity to act as a retroactive audit of institutional time. If quantum decryption renders current cryptographic standards vulnerable, historical archives may become readable, potentially exposing not just sensitive data, but the underlying absence of fiduciary judgment during moments of critical execution. In response to pressures on temporal sovereignty, this paper introduces Systemic Augmented Intelligence (SAI) as a proposed cognitive governance architecture. We argue that in an era of infinite algorithmic generation, institutional authority no longer resides in the capacity to produce, but in the structural architecture of refusal. The human veto is conceptualized as a central locus of cognitive signature and legal responsibility. By transitioning from abstract ethical trust to continuous technical verification, SAI re-establishes the human operator not as a passive observer, but as the structurally embedded governor of systemic risk.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在连续算法执行和量子解密时代，传统间歇性监管框架存在时间不对称问题，导致"认知漂移"风险。作者引入系统性增强智能(SAI)作为认知治理架构，强调人类否决权作为认知签名和法律责任的核心，从抽象伦理信任转向持续技术验证。
AI.research_question: 在连续算法执行和量子解密威胁的背景下，如何重新构建制度治理的时间框架，以防止认知漂移并维护人类在系统风险治理中的核心地位？
AI.motivation: 连续算法执行与量子解密技术挑战了传统制度治理的时间假设，导致监管框架与系统运行的时间不对称，产生"认知漂移"风险，可能使人类判断被机器输出被动验证所取代。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 时间不对称理论：间歇性监管与连续系统运行的结构性不匹配；2) 认知漂移理论：人类判断被机器输出被动验证所取代的过程；3) 系统性增强智能(SAI)框架：将人类否决权作为认知签名和法律责任核心的治理架构。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过理论构建和逻辑论证，分析时间不对称问题，提出SAI作为解决方案。采用跨学科方法，结合制度治理、认知科学和技术哲学视角。
AI.findings: 1) 传统间歇性监管框架在连续算法系统中存在结构性时间不对称；2) 这种不对称导致认知漂移，使人类判断被边缘化；3) HNDL范式放大系统性风险，可能通过量子解密暴露历史决策中的受托责任缺失；4) 在无限算法生成时代，制度权威的关键在于拒绝的结构性架构而非生产能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"认知漂移"概念，解释人类判断被技术系统边缘化的过程；2) 发展系统性增强智能(SAI)理论框架，重新定位人类在算法治理中的核心作用；3) 将人类否决权理论化为认知签名和法律责任的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织设计连续技术验证系统提供架构指导；2) 强调人类否决权在算法治理中的制度嵌入；3) 为应对量子解密威胁下的历史数据风险提供治理框架；4) 推动从抽象伦理原则到具体技术验证的治理转型。

title: Breaking the Link: Risk, Carry, and Commodity Currencies
affiliations: Linkoping University and Linkoping University

detail.title: Breaking the Link: Risk, Carry, and Commodity Currencies
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the stability of the relationship between commodity prices and exchange rates using a novel dataset of daily, country-specific commodity export price indices for ten major commodity-exporting economies. We first show that the relationship between exchange rates and commodity prices varies substantially over time, and at times breaking down entirely. We then examine the state-dependent nature of the commodity-currency relationship using threshold local projections. Our results reveal heterogeneity depending on the source of global risk. Geopolitical risk constitutes a moderator that weakens the commodity-currency link in favor of safe-haven flows into the US, while periods of systemic financial stress amplify the transmission of commodity price shocks. We further show that the use of these currencies as investment vehicles can create speculative crowding. In high-carry regimes, positive commodity shocks trigger profit-taking reversals rather than sustained appreciations. Overall, our findings suggest that the commodity-currency relationship is not as permanent and stable feature as suggested in the existing literature, but rather a conditional state dependent on the global financial and geopolitical environment.

AI.tldr: 本文使用十个主要大宗商品出口经济体的日度国别商品出口价格指数新数据集，研究了大宗商品价格与汇率关系的稳定性。研究发现这种关系随时间变化显著，有时完全中断，并受全球风险和地缘政治风险调节。
AI.research_question: 大宗商品价格与汇率之间的关系是否稳定？这种关系如何受全球风险和地缘政治风险的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将大宗商品-货币关系视为永久稳定的特征，但缺乏对这种关系随时间变化和条件依赖性的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大宗商品-货币关系理论、阈值局部投影方法、全球风险传导机制、地缘政治风险调节效应、套利交易拥挤理论
AI.method: 使用十个主要大宗商品出口经济体的日度国别商品出口价格指数新数据集，采用阈值局部投影方法分析状态依赖性关系
AI.findings: 1) 汇率与大宗商品价格关系随时间显著变化，有时完全中断；2) 地缘政治风险会削弱大宗商品-货币联系，促使避险资金流向美国；3) 系统性金融压力时期会放大大宗商品价格冲击传导；4) 高套利交易制度下，正面的商品冲击会引发获利了结反转而非持续升值
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统文献中大宗商品-货币关系是永久稳定特征的观点，提出了条件状态依赖的新理论框架，强调了全球金融和地缘政治环境的调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了关于大宗商品货币在不同风险环境下的行为预测，有助于风险管理策略制定，特别是对套利交易拥挤效应的认识

title: G.R.A.C.E. for Governance™: A Framework for Sustained Director Effectiveness and the Governance of Self

detail.title: G.R.A.C.E. for Governance™: A Framework for Sustained Director Effectiveness and the Governance of Self
detail.abstract:
Corporate boards globally face a persistent effectiveness deficit that structural governance reforms have failed to resolve. This working paper introduces G.R.A.C.E. for Governance™, a five-dimensional framework that positions the director's capacity for self-governance as the foundational prerequisite of effective board leadership.  

The five dimensions — Governance of Self,  Recovery as Strategy, Awareness in Motion, Community & Cultural 
Immersion, and Equanimity under Pressure — constitute the behavioral infrastructure of directorial effectiveness. 

Drawing on executive resilience research, decision fatigue science, mindful leadership theory, board effectiveness evidence, and embodied cognition, the framework proposes that the biobehavioral governance deficit — the systematic underdevelopment of cognitive, somatic, and relational conditions — is the mechanism that no structural reform has yet addressed. 

A six-question empirical research agenda and a 15-item self-assessment instrument are provided. 

Supplementary materials deposited at Harvard Dataverse: 
https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/73V1UP

AI.tldr: 本文提出G.R.A.C.E.治理框架，认为董事的自我治理能力是有效董事会领导力的基础，强调行为基础设施而非结构改革来解决董事会效能赤字问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过提升董事的自我治理能力来解决全球董事会面临的持续性效能赤字问题？
AI.motivation: 全球董事会面临结构性治理改革未能解决的持续性效能赤字问题，需要新的视角来提升董事会领导力。
AI.theoretical_framework: G.R.A.C.E.治理框架（自我治理、恢复作为战略、动态意识、社区与文化沉浸、压力下的平静），整合了执行韧性研究、决策疲劳科学、正念领导理论、董事会效能证据和具身认知理论。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，提出六项实证研究议程和15项自我评估工具，数据补充材料存放在哈佛Dataverse。
AI.findings: 提出生物行为治理赤字（认知、身体和关系条件的系统性发展不足）是结构性改革尚未解决的机制，需要行为基础设施来提升董事会效能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出G.R.A.C.E.五维治理框架；2. 引入生物行为治理赤字概念；3. 将董事自我治理能力定位为董事会领导力的基础前提。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供15项自我评估工具供董事使用；2. 提出六项实证研究议程指导未来研究；3. 为董事会效能提升提供行为导向的实践框架。

title: A Systematic Review of Financial Technology (FinTech) Innovations and Their Impact on the Indian Banking System
affiliations: D Y Patil School Of Management

detail.title: A Systematic Review of Financial Technology (FinTech) Innovations and Their Impact on the Indian Banking System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary data and published literature; therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Financial Technology (FinTech) has brought significant changes to traditional banking operations worldwide. In India, innovations such as digital wallets, mobile banking, blockchain, artificial intelligence, and the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) have transformed the delivery and accessibility of financial services. This paper presents a systematic review of existing literature to examine the impact of FinTech innovations on the Indian banking system. The study is based on secondary data collected from peer-reviewed journals, Reserve Bank of India reports, and other credible academic sources. The findings indicate that FinTech adoption has enhanced operational efficiency, improved customer experience, and promoted financial inclusion among Indian banks. However, challenges related to cybersecurity risks, regulatory compliance, and high implementation costs persist. The study concludes that FinTech offers substantial opportunities for the banking sector, provided that banks adopt robust risk management practices and align technological strategies with regulatory frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述研究了金融科技（FinTech）创新对印度银行体系的影响，发现FinTech提升了运营效率、改善了客户体验并促进了金融包容性，但也面临网络安全风险、监管合规和高实施成本等挑战。
AI.research_question: 金融科技创新对印度银行体系产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 金融科技在全球范围内给传统银行业务带来了重大变革，印度在数字钱包、移动银行、区块链、人工智能和统一支付接口等创新方面发展迅速，需要系统评估这些创新对印度银行体系的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融科技创新的理论框架，包括技术创新理论、金融服务转型理论和金融包容性理论。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，基于从同行评审期刊、印度储备银行报告和其他可信学术来源收集的二手数据。
AI.findings: FinTech采用提高了印度银行的运营效率，改善了客户体验，并促进了金融包容性；但面临网络安全风险、监管合规挑战和高实施成本等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融科技在发展中国家银行体系中的应用提供了理论见解，丰富了技术创新与金融服务转型的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度银行制定FinTech战略提供实践指导，建议采用稳健的风险管理实践，并将技术战略与监管框架保持一致，以充分利用FinTech带来的机遇。

title: A Legal Theory of State-Owned Enterprises
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: A Legal Theory of State-Owned Enterprises
detail.abstract: Why are state-owned enterprises (SOEs) so prevalent in China, and why do they dominate certain sectors more than others? While current studies provide various political and economic explanations, they fall short of fully accounting for the distribution of SOEs across industries in China. For example, in sectors like infrastructure, the government has actively sought to attract private investment, yet SOEs continue to play a major role. This book introduces a legal theory of SOEs, arguing that the prevalence of SOEs in some sectors in China can be explained by the high regulatory costs associated with regulating the enterprises. Regulatory costs affect state ownership through both the supply-side and demand-side mechanisms. On the supply side, the state would continue to maintain and supply SOEs if it perceives it necessary to maintain control. On the demand side, private investors would refrain from making investment to meet the market demand if they expect the state to frequently adjust regulation that negatively affect their property interests. Therefore, the success of SOE reform is closely linked to the development of robust legal and regulatory institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个关于中国国有企业（SOEs）的法律理论，认为某些行业中国有企业普遍存在的原因在于监管成本过高。监管成本通过供给侧和需求侧机制影响国有所有权：国家为维持控制而继续提供国有企业，而私人投资者因预期监管频繁调整损害其财产利益而回避投资。
AI.research_question: 为什么国有企业在中国如此普遍，且在某些行业比其他行业更占主导地位？
AI.motivation: 现有研究提供了各种政治和经济解释，但未能充分解释中国国有企业在不同行业间的分布模式。例如，在基础设施等政府积极吸引私人投资的行业，国有企业仍扮演主要角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律理论视角下的国有企业理论，强调监管成本对国有企业分布的影响。监管成本通过供给侧机制（国家维持控制的需要）和需求侧机制（私人投资者对监管不确定性的担忧）共同作用。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于监管成本的双重作用机制（供给侧和需求侧）来解释国有企业分布模式。
AI.findings: 国有企业改革成功与否与健全的法律和监管制度发展密切相关。高监管成本导致国家继续维持国有企业（供给侧），同时抑制私人投资（需求侧），从而解释了国有企业在某些行业的持续主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的法律理论来解释国有企业分布，补充了现有政治和经济解释的不足。强调了监管制度在塑造国有企业模式中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国有企业改革提供了政策启示：改革成功需要发展健全的法律和监管制度，降低监管成本，从而减少对国有企业的依赖并促进私人投资。

title: How to Properly Measure Moral Universalism
affiliations: Université de Poitiers, Philosophy Department and Montpellier Business School

detail.title: How to Properly Measure Moral Universalism
detail.abstract: Enke et al. (2022) have introduced the interesting concept of “moral universalism” as “the extent to which people exhibit the same level of altruism and trust toward strangers as toward in-group members”. We argue that concerns arise both regarding the theoretical clarity of the concept and the extent to which it genuinely measures what it purports to measure. We distinguish between four reasons for which some economic considerations are not eliminated as expected, due to confounds related to purchasing power disparities, wealth heterogeneity, and relative socio-economic status, and one reason related to the soundness of the distinction between in-group and out-group in the instructions. We conclude by proposing a revised version of the experimental instructions. Even if the past empirical results would have been unchanged by our proposal, we claim that the revised instructions we propose should be used in the future.

AI.tldr: 该论文对Enke等人(2022)提出的"道德普遍主义"概念提出质疑，指出其理论清晰度和测量效度存在问题，并提出了修订实验指导语的建议。
AI.research_question: Enke等人(2022)提出的"道德普遍主义"概念在理论清晰度和测量效度上存在哪些问题？如何改进相关实验设计？
AI.motivation: Enke等人提出的"道德普遍主义"概念在学术界引起关注，但作者认为该概念在理论定义和测量方法上存在缺陷，需要澄清和改进。
AI.theoretical_framework: 道德普遍主义理论、社会偏好理论、群体间关系理论、实验经济学方法
AI.method: 概念分析和实验设计批判，区分了四种经济考虑未被消除的原因，并提出修订实验指导语的建议
AI.findings: 发现"道德普遍主义"概念存在理论模糊性，测量受到购买力差异、财富异质性、相对社会经济地位等混杂因素的影响，且内群体与外群体的区分在指导语中不够明确
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了"道德普遍主义"概念的理论边界，指出了现有测量方法的局限性，为相关研究提供了更严谨的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了修订的实验指导语，为未来研究提供了更有效的测量工具，有助于提高道德普遍主义研究的信度和效度

title: Attention to Monetary Policy
affiliations: Yonsei University, Yonsei University - School of Economics and Yonsei University, Graduate School

detail.title: Attention to Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: We develop a Google Trends-based Monetary Policy Attention (MPA) index to measure the intensity of public focus on monetary policy. While conducting a series of validation analyses, we find that the MPA index specifically captures search intensity related to monetary policy rather than general economic noise; the index rises significantly with inflation and monetary policy-related uncertainty, while remaining unresponsive to broader economic policy uncertainty. Using a state-dependent local projection method, we examine how the effectiveness of monetary policy shocks varies with the level of attention. We find that during periods of high MPA, monetary policy tightening-even when devoid of signaling components-leads to a divergence between prices and inflation expectations, ultimately attenuating the monetary policy transmission mechanism. These results suggest that high states of public attention can paradoxically hinder the central bank's ability to anchor inflation through traditional interest rate adjustments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了基于谷歌趋势的货币政策关注度指数（MPA），发现高关注度时期货币政策紧缩反而会削弱政策传导机制，阻碍央行通过传统利率调整锚定通胀的能力。
AI.research_question: 公众对货币政策的关注度如何影响货币政策冲击的有效性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏衡量公众对货币政策关注度的有效指标，且不清楚公众关注度如何影响货币政策传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和信息处理理论，关注度影响公众对货币政策信号的理解和反应，进而影响政策传导效果。
AI.method: 1. 开发基于谷歌趋势的货币政策关注度指数（MPA）；2. 进行验证分析确保指数特异性；3. 使用状态依赖的局部投影法分析不同关注度水平下货币政策冲击的效果差异。
AI.findings: 1. MPA指数能特异性捕捉货币政策相关搜索强度，而非一般经济噪音；2. 指数随通胀和货币政策不确定性上升而显著增加，但对更广泛的经济政策不确定性无反应；3. 在高MPA时期，货币政策紧缩（即使不含信号成分）会导致价格与通胀预期分化，削弱货币政策传导机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了衡量公众货币政策关注度的新指标；2. 揭示了公众关注度作为状态依赖因素对货币政策传导的影响机制；3. 提出了"高关注度悖论"——高关注度反而削弱政策有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行提供了监测公众关注度的工具；2. 提示央行在高关注度时期需要调整沟通策略；3. 对货币政策制定者考虑公众心理因素具有重要启示。

title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Carbon Emissions: A Sectoral Analysis of India and Global Trends Against the Paris Agreement Targets

detail.title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Carbon Emissions: A Sectoral Analysis of India and Global Trends Against the Paris Agreement Targets
detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic triggered an unprecedented contraction in global economic activity, producing a rare natural experiment for observing the relationship between human activity and carbon emissions. This paper examines sector-wise variation in CO2 emissions in India and globally during the pandemic year of 2020, using daily near-real-time data from the Carbon Monitor, and benchmarks observed changes against the 7.6% annual reduction target required under the Paris Climate Agreement to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees C. We find a global CO2 decline of 4.57% in 2020 relative to the 2019 baseline, substantially below the Paris-required threshold, and achieved only through the severe disruption of most economic activity. India's overall decline was steeper at 8.33%, driven disproportionately by the industrial sector (-13.92%) and domestic aviation (-45.71%), reflecting the comparative stringency of India's lockdown measures. Critically, emissions in most sectors had substantially recovered to pre-pandemic levels by the second half of 2020, while ground transportation and aviation showed sustained decline through year-end. The findings suggest that pandemic-induced emission reductions represent a temporary and structurally shallow disruption rather than a meaningful contribution to long-term decarbonization, and that achieving Paris targets will require sustained structural transformation across all major emitting sectors.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用COVID-19疫情期间的实时碳排放数据，分析全球和印度2020年碳排放变化，发现疫情导致的减排远未达到巴黎协定要求，且具有临时性，说明实现气候目标需要结构性转型而非经济中断。
AI.research_question: COVID-19疫情期间全球和印度各行业碳排放如何变化？这些变化与巴黎协定要求的减排目标相比如何？疫情导致的减排是否具有可持续性？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情造成了前所未有的全球经济收缩，为观察人类活动与碳排放关系提供了难得的自然实验机会，可以评估疫情导致的减排是否有助于实现巴黎气候协定目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然实验框架，将疫情视为外生冲击，分析经济活动中断与碳排放的关系；结合巴黎协定减排目标作为基准，评估疫情减排效果。
AI.method: 使用Carbon Monitor提供的每日近实时碳排放数据，分析2020年全球和印度各行业碳排放变化，以2019年为基准，并与巴黎协定要求的7.6%年减排目标进行比较。
AI.findings: 全球碳排放下降4.57%，远低于巴黎协定要求的7.6%；印度下降8.33%，主要由工业部门(-13.92%)和国内航空(-45.71%)驱动；大多数行业排放在下半年已恢复至疫情前水平，只有地面交通和航空持续下降至年底。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明疫情导致的减排是临时性、结构浅层的扰动，而非有意义的长期脱碳贡献；强调实现气候目标需要结构性转型，而非经济中断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据：仅靠经济活动中断无法实现巴黎协定目标；识别出地面交通和航空是可能实现持续减排的部门；强调需要针对各主要排放部门实施结构性转型政策。

detail.abstract: It is common knowledge that the adage "It's not about timing the market, but about time in the market" does not hold true in the ship-owning business. Navigating environmental regulations, geopolitical risks, and market timing can either make or break shipowners .

AI.tldr: 论文挑战了"不要择时，而要长期投资"的传统智慧在航运业中的适用性，指出航运业中市场时机、环境法规和地缘政治风险对船东成功至关重要。
AI.research_question: 在航运业中，市场时机、环境法规和地缘政治风险如何影响船东的成功？
AI.motivation: 传统投资智慧认为"不要择时，而要长期投资"，但航运业的特殊性使得这一原则可能不适用，需要研究航运业中市场时机、法规和风险因素的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场时机理论、风险管理理论、航运经济学、环境法规影响理论、地缘政治风险评估框架。
AI.method: 可能采用案例研究、实证分析、历史数据比较、专家访谈等方法，分析航运市场周期、法规变化和地缘政治事件对船东业绩的影响。
AI.findings: 航运业中市场时机至关重要，环境法规和地缘政治风险显著影响船东的成败，成功的船东需要在这些因素上做出正确判断。

AI.practical_contributions: 为船东提供实用的决策框架，帮助他们在复杂环境中做出更好的投资时机判断，规避法规和地缘政治风险，提高经营成功率。

title: Narrative Infrastructure: Micro-Stories as the Constitutive Medium of Organizational Life

detail.title: Narrative Infrastructure: Micro-Stories as the Constitutive Medium of Organizational Life

declarations.ethicsApproval: no ethical issues
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This paper develops a new framework for understanding the role of stories in organizational life. It argues that organizations should not be understood primarily as settings in which leaders use storytelling instrumentally for persuasion, alignment, or change communication. Rather, they should be understood as systems that are continuously organized through micro-stories: small, circulating narrative forms through which organizational members interpret events, infer consequences, define local norms, and orient action. On that basis, the paper introduces the concept of narrative infrastructure to describe the distributed ecology of remembered episodes, cautionary tales, compressed references, and recurring story fragments that connect formal organizational arrangements with lived organizational reality. The paper makes four main contributions. First, it differentiates analytically among storytelling, narrative, and micro-stories, proposing microstories as a formally defined narrative unit distinguishable from scripts, schemas, norms, and rumors, and differentiates narrative infrastructure from the adjacent concept of antenarrative. Second, it shows that micro-stories perform cognitive, social, political, identity-related, and temporal functions in organizations, organized across individual and system levels, while also contributing to the reproduction of silence, fear, and tacit compliance. Third, it conceptualizes organizations as polyphonic story systems and argues that managers require a capability of narrative listening and curation, not only storytelling, in order to understand and influence such systems. Fourth, it shows that the infrastructural role of stories becomes especially consequential 1 I use AI as a research assistant and as an editor. in complex and chaotic environments, where formal categories and linear models provide insufficient guidance for coordinated action. The paper concludes by arguing that change is best understood not simply as the introduction of a better official narrative, but as a shift in the distribution of lived stories inside the organization. In this view, organizations are shaped less by the stories they publish than by the micro-stories their members trust, repeat, contest, and act upon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了理解组织中故事作用的新框架，认为组织不应被视为领导者使用故事进行说服、对齐或变革沟通的场所，而应被视为通过微故事持续组织的系统。微故事是小型、流通的叙事形式，组织成员通过它们解释事件、推断后果、定义本地规范并指导行动。论文引入了"叙事基础设施"概念，描述了连接正式组织安排与组织现实生活的分布式生态。
AI.research_question: 故事在组织生活中扮演什么角色？组织应如何理解故事的作用？微故事如何影响组织运作和变革？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将组织视为领导者使用故事进行工具性沟通的场所，但本文认为这种理解过于简化。需要更深入地理解故事如何真正塑造组织现实，特别是在复杂和混乱的环境中，正式类别和线性模型无法提供足够的协调行动指导。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 微故事理论：将微故事定义为正式定义的叙事单元，区别于脚本、图式、规范和谣言
2. 叙事基础设施：描述连接正式组织安排与组织现实生活的分布式生态
3. 多声部故事系统：将组织概念化为多声部故事系统
4. 叙事倾听与策展能力：管理者需要叙事倾听和策展能力而不仅仅是讲故事能力
AI.method: 本文采用理论构建方法，通过概念分析和理论框架开发来建立新的理解框架。论文没有明确说明经验研究方法，而是通过理论论证和概念区分来建立其论点。
AI.findings:
1. 微故事在组织中执行认知、社会、政治、身份相关和时间功能，跨越个体和系统层面
2. 微故事同时有助于沉默、恐惧和默许合规的再生产
3. 在复杂和混乱环境中，故事的基建作用变得特别重要
4. 变革不应仅仅理解为引入更好的官方叙事，而应理解为组织内部生活故事分布的变化
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 分析区分了讲故事、叙事和微故事，提出微故事作为正式定义的叙事单元
2. 区分了叙事基础设施与相邻的前叙事概念
3. 将组织概念化为多声部故事系统
4. 提出管理者需要叙事倾听和策展能力
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为管理者提供了理解组织现实的新视角
2. 强调管理者需要发展叙事倾听和策展能力，而不仅仅是讲故事能力
3. 为组织变革提供了新思路：关注生活故事的分布变化而非官方叙事的引入
4. 帮助组织在复杂环境中更好地理解和利用故事系统

title: Heterogeneous Oligopolistic Multiproduct Firms and Business Cycle Dynamics
affiliations: Xiamen University - Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE) and

detail.title: Heterogeneous Oligopolistic Multiproduct Firms and Business Cycle Dynamics
detail.abstract: A small number of large firms accounts for a substantial share of aggregate activity. We develop a tractable dynamic general-equilibrium model with heterogeneous granular firms, oligopolistic competition, endogenous product scope, and entry/exit, and show that it admits a unique Markov perfect equilibrium. We introduce a perturbation-based state reduction that delivers near-exact dynamic solutions for fat-tailed Pareto firm-size distributions. Firm-level shocks generate sizable aggregate fluctuations, mainly through the interaction of productivity and endogenous scope. Depending on whether shocks hit a dominant firm or many smaller firms, aggregate effects differ and the cyclicality of aggregate outcomes may reverse.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含异质性大企业、寡头竞争、内生产品范围和进入退出的动态一般均衡模型，展示了企业层面冲击如何通过生产率与内生范围的相互作用产生显著的宏观波动，且冲击对象不同（主导企业vs众多小企业）会导致不同的宏观效应和周期特征反转。
AI.research_question: 少数大型企业如何通过企业层面冲击影响宏观经济波动？企业异质性、内生产品范围和寡头竞争在传导企业冲击到宏观层面的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 少数大型企业占据了经济活动的重要份额，但现有宏观模型未能充分捕捉这种"颗粒性"（granularity）特征及其对宏观经济波动的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态一般均衡模型，包含异质性颗粒企业、寡头竞争、内生产品范围决策、企业进入退出机制，以及基于扰动的状态约简方法处理帕累托厚尾企业规模分布。
AI.method: 构建理论模型并证明存在唯一的马尔可夫完美均衡，采用基于扰动的状态约简技术获得帕累托厚尾企业规模分布的近似精确动态解，进行数值模拟分析。
AI.findings: 企业层面冲击通过生产率与内生产品范围的相互作用产生显著的宏观波动；冲击对象不同（主导企业vs众多小企业）会导致不同的宏观效应和周期特征反转。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了包含异质性大企业、寡头竞争和内生产品范围的动态一般均衡模型；2) 提出了处理帕累托厚尾分布的扰动状态约简方法；3) 揭示了企业层面冲击传导到宏观层面的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解大型企业冲击对宏观经济的影响提供了理论框架，有助于评估不同类型企业冲击（如主导企业技术冲击vs中小企业普遍冲击）的宏观效应差异。

title: Suspicion and Communication
affiliations: University of Potsdam, University of Potsdam and

detail.title: Suspicion and Communication
detail.abstract: In this paper, we study how communication influences suspicion. The experiment uses a sender-receiver setup with a low probability of misaligned incentives for senders and receivers. We focus on the impact of open communication on the receivers' suspicion as measured by the size of the deviation from the senders' recommendation before and after the communication. Overall, communication substantially reduces suspicion, but some receivers become more suspicious during the communication. We disentangle these effects using machine learning methods to analyze the chat logs.

AI.tldr: 研究沟通如何影响怀疑的实验：在发送者-接收者设置中，开放沟通显著降低接收者的怀疑，但部分接收者在沟通过程中反而变得更加怀疑。
AI.research_question: 沟通如何影响接收者对发送者建议的怀疑程度？
AI.motivation: 理解在激励不完全一致的情况下，沟通对信任和怀疑的动态影响，特别是在低概率激励错配的情境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发送者-接收者博弈理论，结合沟通经济学和信任理论，分析开放沟通对怀疑心理的影响机制。
AI.method: 实验方法：采用发送者-接收者设置，激励错配概率较低；测量接收者对发送者建议的偏离程度作为怀疑指标；使用机器学习方法分析聊天记录以解构效应。
AI.findings: 1. 整体上，沟通显著降低接收者的怀疑程度；2. 但部分接收者在沟通过程中反而变得更加怀疑；3. 通过机器学习分析聊天记录能够解构这些异质性效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了沟通对怀疑的非线性影响；2. 提供了在低概率激励错配情境下沟通效应的实证证据；3. 展示了机器学习在分析沟通动态中的方法论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织中的沟通策略提供指导；2. 帮助管理者理解沟通可能产生的信任和怀疑双重效应；3. 提供分析沟通内容的工具方法。

title: Co-creation and Multilevel-Governance: A Literature Report
affiliations: Université de Lausanne, University of Lausanne - Institut d'Etudes Politiques et Internationales,  and University of Berne

detail.title: Co-creation and Multilevel-Governance: A Literature Report
detail.abstract: As the EU advances its green and digital "twin transitions," public authorities seek governance approaches that link policy innovation with democratic legitimacy and delivery capacity. This report clarifies the meaning of co-creation in public governance and examines how it can be embedded within multilevel governance (MLG) so legitimacy, effectiveness, and inclusion reinforce one another across local, regional, national, and EU levels. Based on a narrative review of 111 publications, it shows that co-creation involves collaborative practices across the policy cycle-joint problem framing, design, implementation, and evaluation-engaging citizens, public institutions, civil-society organisations, businesses, and experts. While most practice occurs locally, higher tiers shape mandates, resources, standards, and digital platforms that enable or constrain experimentation and diffusion. The analysis identifies key benefits, including improved democratic legitimacy, knowledge quality, service and policy outcomes, and social cohesion, alongside risks such as tokenism, elite capture, representation gaps, digital exclusion, and limited scaling. When adequately supported, co-creation complements representative democracy and strengthens MLG's problem-solving capacity. (Rethinking Co-Creation of Digital and Environmental Policy in Systems of Multilevel Governance) MLG, Horizon Europe Project. Project no. 101177521. We thank Stefan Gänzle, Amanda Manchin, Jacob Torfing, and Pieter Velghe for their very helpful written comments on an earlier version of the report. Furthermore, we thank Katherine Arena,

AI.research_question: 在欧盟多层治理体系中，如何通过共创将政策创新与民主合法性、执行能力有效结合？
AI.motivation: 欧盟推进绿色和数字"双转型"过程中，公共机构需要既能促进政策创新，又能确保民主合法性和执行能力的治理方法。

AI.method: 对111篇文献进行叙事性综述，分析共创在多层治理中的实践模式
AI.findings: 共创涉及政策周期的协作实践，主要在地方层面实施，但高层级影响其运作条件；共创能提升民主合法性、知识质量、政策成果和社会凝聚力，但也存在象征主义、精英俘获、代表性不足等风险。

title: A Multi-Model Analysis of the Short-Run and Long-Run Effects of Environmental Taxes and Renewable Energy on Decarbonization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Azerbaijan State University of Economics (UNEC) and

detail.title: A Multi-Model Analysis of the Short-Run and Long-Run Effects of Environmental Taxes and Renewable Energy on Decarbonization
detail.abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of economic instruments in reducing carbon dioxide emissions in OECD countries. The focus is on renewable energy consumption and environmental taxation. Previous studies often report that both instruments reduce emissions. However, much of the literature relies on single econometric methods. This may overlook cross country heterogeneity, cross sectional dependence, and dynamic adjustment effects. To address these limitations, this study applies a multi model panel econometric framework using balanced OECD data from 2000 to 2022. Fixed effects, mean group, pooled mean group, and common correlated effects estimators are employed. These methods allow the identification of both short run and long run relationships while accounting for unobserved common factors. The results show that renewable energy consumption consistently and significantly reduces carbon dioxide emissions across all model specifications. The effect is stronger in the long run. In contrast, environmental tax revenue shows weak and unstable effects that depend on model choice. Economic growth does not have a significant long run impact on emissions. This suggests that efficiency gains and technological progress dominate scale effects in advanced economies. The findings highlight the importance of methodological robustness and support prioritizing renewable energy expansion over environmental taxation alone.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用多模型面板计量框架分析OECD国家经济工具对二氧化碳排放的影响。结果显示可再生能源消费能持续显著降低排放，而环境税收效果较弱且不稳定。经济增长对排放无显著长期影响。
AI.research_question: 经济工具（可再生能源消费和环境税收）在减少OECD国家二氧化碳排放方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 先前研究多依赖单一计量方法，可能忽略国家异质性、横截面依赖性和动态调整效应，需要更稳健的方法论框架来准确评估政策工具效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的经济工具理论，包括庇古税和环境政策有效性理论，以及经济增长与环境关系的规模效应、技术效应和结构效应理论。
AI.method: 采用多模型面板计量框架，使用OECD国家2000-2022年平衡数据，应用固定效应、均值组、混合均值组和共同相关效应估计方法，考虑短期和长期关系及未观测共同因素。
AI.findings: 1. 可再生能源消费在所有模型设定中均显著降低二氧化碳排放，长期效果更强；2. 环境税收收入效果较弱且不稳定，依赖模型选择；3. 经济增长对排放无显著长期影响，表明效率提升和技术进步主导了规模效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了更稳健的方法论框架处理面板数据中的异质性和依赖性；2. 区分了不同经济工具的短期和长期效果；3. 验证了在发达经济体中技术进步主导经济增长环境效应的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 支持优先发展可再生能源而非单纯依赖环境税收；2. 为政策制定者提供实证依据，强调政策工具组合的重要性；3. 强调方法稳健性在政策评估中的关键作用。

title: Revisiting the Limits of Antitrust: Humility, Legitimacy, Justice
affiliations: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC) and Compass Lexecon

detail.title: Revisiting the Limits of Antitrust: Humility, Legitimacy, Justice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Cani Fernández has no conflict of interest to declare. Jorge Padilla is solely compensated by Compass Lexecon, an eco-nomic consultancy. detail.abstract: In this Article we argue that contemporary antitrust disagreements are at heart conflicts between competing teleological frameworks, rather than disputes about economics, evidence, or enforcement attitude. We compares three influential approaches-consumer welfare, republican non-domination, and common good constitutionalism-as alternative second-best enforcement responses to uncertainty and epistemic limits. The analysis shows that these frameworks diverge along four dimensions: moral thickness, normative closure, sensitivity to ex-post injustice, and institutional design. While all reject first-best optimization, they propose sharply different ways of governing persistent disagreement. We conclude that antitrust regimes that institutionalize fallibility offer greater legitimacy and durability than those that seek to resolve uncertainty through authoritative moral settlement. Such regimes adopt a form of "republican welfarism," in which welfare remains the ultimate evaluative standard for rule selection, but its pursuit is constrained by a republican concern with non-domination. This constraint increases the legitimacy of welfare optimization where enforcement would generate arbitrary or irreversible harm.

AI.tldr: 本文认为当代反垄断分歧本质上是不同目的论框架之间的冲突，而非经济学、证据或执法态度的争议。文章比较了消费者福利、共和非支配和共同善宪政主义三种有影响力的方法，提出"共和福利主义"作为更具合法性和持久性的制度设计。
AI.research_question: 当代反垄断分歧的本质是什么？不同目的论框架如何影响反垄断执法？何种制度设计能更好地处理不确定性和认识局限？
AI.motivation: 当前反垄断领域存在深刻分歧，传统上这些分歧被理解为经济学、证据或执法态度的争议，但作者认为这些分歧实际上反映了更深层的不同目的论框架之间的冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 消费者福利框架（Consumer Welfare）
2. 共和非支配框架（Republican Non-domination）
3. 共同善宪政主义（Common Good Constitutionalism）
4. 共和福利主义（Republican Welfarism）
AI.method: 理论比较分析：比较三种有影响力的反垄断目的论框架，分析它们在四个维度上的差异：道德厚度、规范性封闭性、对事后不公正的敏感性、制度设计。
AI.findings:
1. 三种框架都拒绝最优优化，但提出了截然不同的治理持续分歧的方式
2. 这些框架在四个维度上存在显著差异
3. 将易错性制度化的反垄断制度比通过权威道德解决来消除不确定性的制度更具合法性和持久性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出反垄断分歧本质上是目的论框架冲突的新视角
2. 发展"共和福利主义"理论框架，将福利作为规则选择的最终评估标准，但受共和非支配原则约束
3. 为处理反垄断领域的不确定性和认识局限提供新的理论路径
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为反垄断执法机构提供更具合法性和持久性的制度设计思路
2. 当执法可能产生任意或不可逆伤害时，共和约束能增加福利优化的合法性
3. 为政策制定者处理反垄断分歧提供实践指导

title:
The Blind Side of the AI and Robotics Revolution:
When Productivity Forgets the People Who are Supposed to Buy the Output

detail.title:
The Blind Side of the AI and Robotics Revolution:
When Productivity Forgets the People Who are Supposed to Buy the Output
detail.abstract:
This article explores the systemic risks inherent in the current AI and robotics revolution, focusing on the "blind side" of the productivity miracle: the erosion of the demand engine. While global discourse frequently celebrates the efficiency gains and cost reductions brought about by automation, this paper argues that if these gains accrue primarily to capital while labor’s bargaining power and income share continue to decouple from productivity, the result is not a "golden age" but rather economic "involution." I define this phenomenon as a state of hyper-competition for shrinking margins, characterized by price wars and a consumption collapse driven by missing purchasing power rather than a lack of products. Drawing on historical parallels—including the economic stagnation of the later Roman Empire—and contemporary data regarding the global decline of the labor share, the article posits that a modern economy cannot be sustained by capital expenditure and asset re-pricing alone.

The central thesis emphasizes that labor serves a dual role: it is not merely a cost of production but the primary mechanism for distributing the purchasing power necessary to clear markets. When the "shared story" of a fair economic bargain weakens, the social and political coordination required to maintain complex systems begins to fail. The paper warns that without proactive strategies to ensure that the gains of AI are broadly distributed to maintain a robust consumer class, the widening imbalance between production capacity and household income will lead to structural deflation, political breakage, and the eventual snapping of the social contract.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI和机器人革命中的系统性风险，聚焦生产力奇迹的"盲区"：需求引擎的侵蚀。文章认为如果自动化收益主要流向资本而非劳动力，将导致经济"内卷化"而非"黄金时代"，最终引发结构性通缩和政治断裂。
AI.research_question: AI和机器人革命如何通过侵蚀需求引擎（劳动力购买力）产生系统性风险，以及这种失衡对经济和社会稳定的影响？
AI.motivation: 当前全球讨论过度关注自动化的效率提升和成本降低，却忽视了收益分配不均导致的购买力下降问题。这种失衡可能破坏经济稳定和社会契约，需要系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 劳动力双重角色理论：既是生产成本又是购买力分配机制；2) 经济内卷化理论：超竞争状态下利润率收缩；3) 社会契约理论：公平经济交易的社会协调功能；4) 历史类比：罗马帝国后期的经济停滞。
AI.method: 理论分析结合历史比较（罗马帝国案例）和当代数据（全球劳动力份额下降趋势），采用系统性风险分析框架。
AI.findings: 1) AI收益主要流向资本导致劳动力购买力下降；2) 生产能力和家庭收入失衡引发结构性通缩；3) 经济内卷化表现为价格战和消费崩溃；4) 社会政治协调机制可能失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"需求引擎侵蚀"作为AI革命系统性风险的核心机制；2) 发展"经济内卷化"概念框架；3) 完善劳动力双重角色理论；4) 建立历史比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 警示政策制定者关注AI收益分配问题；2) 提出需要主动策略确保AI收益广泛分配；3) 为企业和政府提供风险预警框架；4) 强调维护强大消费阶层的重要性。
